name: Kirioka Chitose
source:
President of Kirigaoka Gakuin, and Taiki's sister-in-law. Although Chitose is in her mid-twenties, her physical growth had stopped as a child due to an accident in the past. As a result, she permanently looks like an elementary school student. 
She loves her brother-in-law very much and is often ridiculed for it.

[Translated from the [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monochrome_(%E3%82%B2%E3%83%BC%E3%83%A0)]Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
